create_distribution_negative_binomial: create a NegativeBinomial distribution with total_count and probs or logits parameters
sample_from_distribution: sample from a NegativeBinomial distribution with a given sample shape
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a NegativeBinomial distribution
expand_distribution: expand a NegativeBinomial distribution to a new batch shape
get_distribution_mean: get the mean of a NegativeBinomial distribution from total_count and logits
